5. **Meaning dropped from the old line — none that matters.** The qualifier 「系统写」 (「D9 系统写盖章」 → 「D9 盖章」) is gone. ADR-0131 D9 IS the system-insert stamp rule (`resolveSystemInsertOrganization`), so with the section named the referent is unambiguous; and the same schema predicate also decides the elevated-write audit mute in `buildDriverOptions`, so the wider wording is the more accurate one. Accepted.
6. **Direction of 「才」 — a reading note, not a defect.** 「有租户列且非联邦才在内」 literally states the necessary arm (in scope ONLY IF column ∧ ¬federated); the sufficient arm (column ∧ ¬federated ⇒ in scope) is the conventional reading and is what the engine implements (an iff). At 119 of 120 bytes there is no room for a second arm; the card asked for one line at the same byte cap and got it.
7. **Ratchet facts re-measured from the committed tree, not the dev report — right.** File 460 lines at head and at `origin/main`; line 403 is 119 bytes at head (120 at main; cap 120); longest line in the file 120 bytes. No ceiling moved; the diff is one hunk, +1/−1; nothing else on the page moves.
